block.fw_rocketry.launch_pad.desc: Place a rocket on top of this
item.fw_rocketry.rocket_t1.desc: Flies to the Moon. Place on a launch pad, fuel it (4 rocket fuel) and press jump while seated.
item.fw_rocketry.rocket_t2.desc: Flies to Mars. Place on a launch pad, fuel it (8 rocket fuel) and press jump while seated.
item.fw_rocketry.rocket_fuel.desc: Right-click a rocket to fuel it
msg.fw_rocketry.pad: Rockets must be placed on a launch pad
msg.fw_rocketry.board: Press jump to launch. Sneak to get out.
